ev.q: Prevalence of early introduction varied across sociodemographic groups
Percentage of infants introduced to complementary foods before age 4 months, by sociodemographic characteristics
Nearly one in six infants is introduced to complementary foods before age 4 months
Among 23,743 children aged 1–5 years, the mean age at introduction of complementary foods was 5.7 months
Prevalence of early introduction was 15.6% nationally
Prevalence of early introduction was significantly higher among non-Hispanic Black (Black) children (25.2%), compared with all other racial/ethnic groups
CDC analyzed 2016–2018 data from the National Survey of Children’s Health (NSCH)
